title: Reduce 222-WIC-8106 Output Ramp Rate to Minimise CV-005 Surging

fields.latestPosition: PTS to review implementation (04/09). Earlier note (28/08) recorded that evidence of surging caused by the PID was not found.
fields.nextAction: Close out the review and confirm proceed or cancel.
fields.statusConflict: Form attributes CV-005 surging to the PID; 28/08 review found no evidence of this
fields.why: 222-WIC-8106 produces significant reclaim feed surges on CV-005 during feed rate increases. Trends show a stable 260 t/h setpoint while measured feed spikes to about 640 t/h, despite small output changes (~63–66% CV). Feeder demand increases faster than the transport delay between FE-005/006/007/008 and the CV-005 weightometer, so material arrives in slugs rather than a controlled increase.
fields.design:
- Modify positive output ramping of 222-WIC-8106 Crushed Ore Stockpile Reclaim Feed Rate Controller to match reclaim system deadtime
- Retune the control loop to reduce responsiveness
fields.impact: Less operator intervention needed to manage reclaim feed surges; feed increases will ramp more slowly.
